did: Fixed server#879: home now takes a re-stamped call week in as a new, appended revision while no part of it has a video, so 2026-11-06 can render as template v5 parts. The record is append-only (call_week_revision). file_host gives the newest revision beside the week as .next, and the render worker alone takes it in before a job, drops the count and the work, and records which revision it took. Three independent reviews found races in two earlier designs; each was raised as drift and the shape changed twice, to one actor owning the take-in. Six fresh-context reviews were recorded on the PR, the last one clean.
